text.p: Shares of Geotek Communications Inc rallied further Tuesday on expectations that its expanded alliance with IBM will bolster the wireless communication company's revenues, traders said.
Geotek, the most active Nasdaq issue, gained 1-1/8 points to 6 in afternoon trading, building on gains seen Monday after the IBM pact was announced. Geotek added 1-3/32 points on Monday.

Under the accord announced Monday, IBM will act as prime contractor to develop and supply enhanced features for key elements of Geotek systems, including switching and switching control systems. The two sides estimated the value of the first phase of the contract in the U.S. alone at $50 million. Worldwide equipment sales could reach $150 million under the accord, they said.
Geotek's chief executive Yaron Eitan told CNBC that he expects Geotek to see a better earnings picture "starting this quarter."

Eitan also told CNBC that "starting the second quarter, we will start the process of increasing the revenues month by month to a point that we'll be able to generate a positive cash flow in all the markets we have launched in 1997 within 12 to 18 months."
